hypothesis: The unchanged Donchian 120/60 policy may have positive absolute net performance after costs and may add value relative to the frozen M17.2 train-calibrated passive portfolio; these are separate claims.

evaluation.selection_basis: completed calendar months January through September 2026; selected before acquisition or strategy evaluation and not from returns

strategy.entry: at close(T), close(T) > maximum high of the previous 120 closed 4h candles, excluding T
strategy.exit: at close(T), close(T) < minimum low of the previous 60 closed 4h candles, excluding T
strategy.execution: fill only at the next exactly consecutive 4h candle open; cancel stale pending signals
strategy.position: long-only flat/long; no leverage, short, pyramiding, stop, target, scaling, ML, ranking, news, regime or liquidity gate
strategy.initial_state: flat at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z with no inherited position or pending signal

benchmarks.buyhold_full: 100% initial capital divided equally across seven assets, one entry at path start, no rebalance, terminal liquidation

buyhold_calibrated.description: frozen fraction invested equally at path start, remainder held as zero-yield cash, no rebalance, terminal liquidation
buyhold_calibrated.risk_warning: realized evaluation-period risk is not forced to match strategy risk

costs.accounting: actual traded notional on every entry and exit
costs.double_role: predefined robustness stress; secondary and unable to rescue a failed primary claim

terminal: cancel pending orders and liquidate every open strategy and passive position at the 2026-09-30T20:00:00Z candle close, producing the 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z terminal equity mark with scenario costs

data_acquisition.primary_source: Binance public monthly Spot kline archives
data_acquisition.files: January through September 2026 monthly 4h archives and their official .CHECKSUM files for each frozen symbol
data_acquisition.preservation: preserve downloaded archives, official checksum files, archive SHA-256, retrieval UTC time, source URL and normalized-file SHA-256
data_acquisition.fallback: none; missing archives or checksum failures produce DATA_ACQUISITION_BLOCKED and require a versioned protocol review before another source is used

archive_schema.official_timestamp_note: Binance public Spot archives use microsecond timestamps from 2025-01-01 onward; this must still be validated on every acquired file
archive_schema.timestamp_validation: require integer open_time and close_time with microsecond magnitude for 2026; convert explicitly as UTC microseconds; reject ambiguous units, mixed units, overflow, non-UTC alignment or undocumented schema changes
archive_schema.interval_validation: open_time must align to a UTC 4h boundary; close_time must represent the same 4h candle; open times must be unique and strictly increasing
archive_schema.value_validation: exactly 12 fields; finite positive OHLC; low<=open/close<=high; nonnegative volume and trade count
archive_schema.range_validation: evaluation open times must be exactly the common grid [2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z) at 4h frequency

daily_endpoint.marks: UTC midnight equity marks including path start and terminal path end

co_primary_questions.absolute: Strategy mean daily net return versus zero-yield cash under base costs
co_primary_questions.incremental: paired mean daily net-return difference Strategy minus frozen-lambda calibrated passive under base costs

reported_metrics: mean daily net return versus cash
paired mean daily difference versus calibrated passive
trade count and mean/median holding duration

uncertainty.method: paired non-overlapping calendar-time block bootstrap using block sums and counts
uncertainty.alignment: exact complete UTC-day endpoints; no dropna and no mixing windows
uncertainty.raw_intervals: two-sided 95% bootstrap intervals for each co-primary estimate
uncertainty.multiplicity: two co-primary claims use Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided 97.5% intervals (1.25% and 98.75% quantiles); secondary comparisons are descriptive

subwindow_role: descriptive stability slices of the single continuous path; no reset, refit, tuning or independent-evidence claim
result_access_rule: No acquisition or evaluation before protocol review and a separately authorized milestone. After first result access, no silent rerun, replacement window or parameter change is allowed.
implementation_correction_rule: Any material defect found after opening data requires a versioned correction that preserves the original result and explicitly records loss of holdout cleanliness.

prospective_alternative.status: proposal only; requires separate review and protocol before monitoring or acquisition
prospective_alternative.substitution_rule: cannot replace the 2026 January-September candidate after viewing its result

forbidden: strategy, lookback, universe, cost, lambda, threshold or feature changes
optimizer, model training, benchmark search or post-result window selection
automatic paper, shadow or live promotion
overwriting frozen or newly acquired raw data
